test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the context of the following sentence.

The __palm__ is a native of Malaysia. We can find them in groves.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "A type of tree".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"palm"** in the given context refers to a type of tree, specifically a tropical plant typically found in regions such as Malaysia. (हथेली का पेड़)

 
 
• **Example:** The palm trees swayed gently in the tropical breeze.
 
 
 
• The inner surface of the hand is also known as the "palm," but in this context, it refers to the tree. (हथेली - हाथ का अंदरूनी हिस्सा)
 
 
• **Example:** He wrote the address on the palm of his hand.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the context of the sentence, "The palm is a native of Malaysia. We can find them in groves," the correct meaning of "palm" is a type of tree.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A type of soil** (मिट्टी का प्रकार): Refers to a classification of soil, such as clay, sand, or loam.

 
 
• **Example:** Farmers prefer fertile soil for growing crops.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: A pamphlet** (पुस्तिका): A small booklet or leaflet containing information or arguments about a particular subject.
 
 
• **Example:** The company distributed a pamphlet to promote their new product.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Inner surface of the hand** (हथेली): Refers to the inner part of the human hand.
 
 
• **Example:** The fortune teller claimed to read the future by examining the lines on my palm.
 
 

3d:T88b,

The correct answer is **option 2.**
